correction2_docLifecycle.was: Said nothing reconnects by itself and human control always needs another explicit takeover after re-auth.
correction2_docLifecycle.now: Matches the implemented code: passive picture recovery retries boundedly (at most three consecutive attempts, then parked until the status channel recovers) and reconnects only once a request passes authorization again; authentication alone never grants control — authority returns only through a fresh requester-bound receipt (a status poll or takeover answer naming this device, held true, current generation+epoch); a still-valid same-client human lease may be re-proved by such a receipt without a new takeover, and an explicit takeover is required only when the lease is absent, expired or held by another device. No draft, queued input, main Conversation or Agent execution is ever implicitly replayed or resumed. Notes that accepted R12 recovery observed the first device passive and did not establish a blanket always-passive same-client lease guarantee. Application revocation is described through the protected Access edge (the origin verifies each freshly presented assertion and keeps no revocation list), not as an origin-side revocation list.
